surprises: The pre-existing `-All` branch has excluded self since it was written, but the SINGLE-serial branch never did -- so the one form an agent actually types at itself was the only unguarded one. The guard existed, on the wrong path.

PowerShell will not dot-source a file lacking a .ps1 extension, and it fails in a way that looks exactly like a clean negative result (no output, zero recorded actions). This produced a false 'the old script is safe' reading for one run.

An array splat turns '-All' into a POSITIONAL argument, so the switch silently became a serial string and failed validation -- and two failed runs then compared IDENTICAL. Empty-vs-empty is the vacuous-pass shape; only the denominator exposed it.
